name: Wolfgang
self_text: I’m a Nigerian designer in my 50s, studying programming to blend logic with creativity. I thrive in step‑by‑step walkthrough sessions and need complete silence to focus. I’m happy to explain things when I help others. I can meet in person, and I’m free Saturday morning or Sunday morning. Outside work I love woodworking; shaping wood feels grounding and lets me craft something tangible. I enjoy quiet moments in a cozy workshop, surrounded by tools and the scent of fresh pine.

requests.request_text: I need you to be okay with talking things through as we go, you must be into a step-by-step walkthrough session, and you must be the one who has things explained by me. I'd strongly prefer that we overlap on in person, though it's not a requirement. A small bonus if you are into language practice or statistics, and a nice if you are available any of Saturday morning or Sunday morning.
